written: 25 Oct 2026, before agent run 1 (plan rev 2.1 section 3; thresholds set after the probe, before any run)
how: the lab exports the run's saved design (every body), slices it with PrusaSlicer 2.9.2 and the stock 0.20mm SPEED @MK4S 0.4 + Prusament PLA @MK4S + Original Prusa MK4S 0.4 nozzle presets (only --binary-gcode=0), and measures every layer that holds text, found from the run's own design (raised: above the tag's top face; engraved: the slots below it)
pass_when_all: both rows found: row 1 has 4 letter pieces (ALEX), row 2 (the smaller row) has 6 (GYM BAG, the space has none)
glyph and counter counts of both rows match the design on every text layer (no letter splits, merges, vanishes, no counter or island lost)
raised: each row-2 letter's planned area is within 15% of its designed area (0.85 to 1.15) and at most 25% of it uncovered
engraved: each row-2 slot's open area is 0.85 to 1.15 of its designed area, at most 25% of it filled, and each plastic island inside a letter at least 50% printed
the key-ring hole is open on every layer (at least half its area free of plastic)
fail_also_when: row 2 missing or with a different number of letters
the text is not on the tag (no text layers found)
the text is a separate body (two or more bodies in the saved design)
reported: the cap height (mm) and mode (raised / engraved) each run chose
whether its session log shows it compared text size with the nozzle or the slicer
